There should fuzzers that can find the CVE (where it makes sense).
I think at least the following CVE should be covered by a fuzzer, which might need to extend an existing fuzzer. They all seem to be memory corruption or NULL pointer deference, which the fuzzer should be able to report.
- CVE-2026-22796: PKCS#7
- CVE-2026-22795: PKCS#12
- CVE-2025-69421: PKCS#12
- CVE-2025-69420: TS_RESP_verify_response
- CVE-2025-69419: PKCS#12
- CVE-2025-68160: BIO filter
- CVE-2025-15468: SSL_CIPHER_find() using QUIC
- CVE-2025-15467: CMS
- CVE-2025-11187: PKCS#12
- CVE-2025-9232: HTTP client
- CVE-2025-9230: CMS
